key_findings.finding: In complex real-repo tasks (such as tui-wrap), multi-round auto-fix attempts oscillated or degraded instead of converging, hitting the 600s hard task timeout limit (642s/644s) and burning 4 model calls per trial with 0 delivery.

Single model direct dispatches exhibited 100% delivery rate with significantly lower latency (Claude P50: 115.3s, Codex P50: 182.4s), but still suffered 75%-100% delivered defect rates under hidden oracle tests (e.g. ANSI escape handling / column wrap boundary offsets).

Unconstrained parallel race execution allowed slow or failing competitor processes to run to completion even after a candidate had successfully passed all verification gates, consuming unnecessary provider quota.
